308-346971 ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAND EASEMENT AGREEMENT THIS ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION(this“Assignment")is made as of June 9, 2011 by U.S. BANK NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, a national banking association, in its capacity as agent and administrative bank ("Assignor"), having an address at U.S. Bancorp Center, 800 Nicollet Mall, Minneapolis, Minnesota 55402, to and in favor of 39 WEST 23RD STREET LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Assignee"), having an address c/o Anbau Enterprises, Inc., 206 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York 10010. WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Louis & Sons Inc., James Woolery a/k/a James C. Woolery, Ellen Peckham, Michael J. Spano, Patrick Montgomery and Jerilyn Tabor Montgomery (collectively, the “"Unit Owners"), The Board of Managers of the 35 West 23?d Street Condominium (the "Board") and 23"d Street Development LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Developer") are parties to a certain Zoning Lot and Development and Easement Agreement dated as of September 19, 2005 (the “ZLDA") recorded in the Office of the City Register, New York County (the “Register's Office"), on January 11, 2006 under CRFN# 2006000018146, relating to certain real property situated in the City of New York, County of New York, State of New York, as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Premises"); and WHEREAS,Developer subsequently granted to Assignor a certain Project Mortgage, Security Agreement, Assignment of Leases and Rents and Fixture Filing dated as of July 20, 2007 (the “"Mortgage"), and recorded in the Register's Office on July 31, 2007, under CRFN #2007000395852,encumbering thePremises; and WHEREAS, Developer defaulted under the Mortgage, and Assignor thereafter commenced a foreclosure proceeding in the Supreme Court of the State of New York, County of New York (the “Court"), under Index No. 600160/2009 (the “Foreclosure Action"), and a Judgment of Foreclosure and Sale was issued in favor of Assignor in the Foreclosure Action and entered with the Court on July 23, 2010 (the “Judgment"); and WHEREAS, Assignor was the successful bidder at the sale held pursuant to said Judgment on May 18, 2011 at the New York County Courthouse, 60 Centre Street, Room 130, New York, New York; and WHEREAS, concurrently herewith Assignor is assigning its bid to Assignee by Assignment of Bid dated as of the date hereof; and WHEREAS, pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the ZLDA, Assignor is permitted to assign its interest in the ZLDA without the prior written consent of the Board provided that Assignee, its successors and assigns, assume Developer's obligations under the ZLDA for the benefitof theBoard and theUnit Owners;and 124670.00410/6961203v.2
